name: app_es_vip
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.app_es_vip()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    (select u.full_access and u.activo
       from app_usuarios u
      where u.user_id = auth.uid()
      limit 1), false);
$function$

name: app_puede_borrar
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.app_puede_borrar()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
  select case when app_es_vip() then true else coalesce(
    (select u.puede_eliminar and u.activo from app_usuarios u where u.user_id = auth.uid() limit 1), false) end;
$function$

name: app_registrado
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.app_registrado()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
  select exists (select 1 from app_usuarios u where u.user_id = auth.uid() and u.activo);
$function$

name: app_rol
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.app_rol()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    (select u.rol from app_usuarios u
      where u.user_id = auth.uid() and u.activo limit 1), 'SIN_ACCESO');
$function$

name: app_ve_obra
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.app_ve_obra(p_obra uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when (select auth.uid()) is null then false
    when public.app_es_vip() then true
    else exists (
      select 1
        from public.app_usuarios u
        join public.obras o on o.id = p_obra
       where u.user_id = (select auth.uid())
         and u.activo
         and cardinality(u.empresas_permitidas) > 0
         and o.empresa_codigo = any(u.empresas_permitidas)
         and (
           cardinality(u.obras_permitidas) = 0
           or p_obra = any(u.obras_permitidas)
         )
    )
  end;
$function$

name: control_puede_ver_salud
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.control_puede_ver_salud()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.app_usuarios u
    where u.user_id=(select auth.uid()) and u.activo
      and u.rol in ('ADMIN','CONTADOR')
  );
$function$
